phase3_findings.description: Whitespace-only login is classified human. is_human tests blankness only as ($l != ""), so a login of " " / "\t" satisfies all four conjuncts and is counted as human rework, contradicting the change's stated 'non-blank string' / 'unknown is not a human' contract. Uncovered by any fixture; latent — reintroduces the false positive if the API ever returns a whitespace-padded unresolved local-tier identity. Suggested fix: strip/validate whitespace and add a fixture expecting 0.
phase3_findings.over_grade_annotation: suspected over-grade: shape 3 — uncorroborated single-source Important from pr-test-analyzer, no other Phase-3 corroboration and no Phase-2 FAIL; observable fail-direction is a contrived-input over-count (fails toward the false positive the PR fixes), milder than the Important label. Advisory only; verdict unchanged.

phase3_findings.description: Silent drop of a genuinely-human commit whose login the API returned blank (documented intentional 'unknown is not a human' tradeoff; fails in the safe direction — under-counts). Consider a stderr breadcrumb when a non-empty tail was dropped solely for blank login. Non-blocking, design bias documented.

Anchor select and is_human compare == $author without an empty-$author guard; if AUTHOR were empty a blank-login commit would both match the bot anchor and be excluded from is_human. Pre-existing (== $author comparisons unchanged); AUTHOR is normally the [bot]-stripped non-empty PR author, so latent only.

Test-side selection uses non-preflight tools (grep/sed/cut/head). This is harness code and fails closed (empty extraction -> assertion RED), so compliant in spirit with CLAUDE.md's non-preflight-PATH-tool rule; noted only because the same shape in a shipped helper would be a real defect.

Over-length inline comment block above POST_BOT_COMMITS (~11 physical lines carrying derivation/rationale beyond naming the prevented wrong change). Under the prevention-only comment standard (>3 lines; derivation rather than a named wrong change) it is a Suggestion. Accurate against HEAD — no documented_falsehood.
Over-length #1440 test comment block in lib/test/run.sh (~7 physical lines mixing behavioral spec with provenance). Exceeds the three-line prevention-only cap; Suggestion. Accurate against HEAD.

The '#1440: the shipped POST_BOT_COMMITS block extracted cleanly' assertion only checks the substring POST_BOT_COMMITS= is present, so it passes on a truncated (start-anchor-present) program; the real drift guard is the fixture rows. Rename to reflect it guards the start anchor only, or strengthen it to also assert the trailing terminator ')" is present.

Cross-attributed commits (bot author + human committer, and the reverse) are untested. They are structurally excluded from the counted tail (become anchors via the either-login bot-index select) — correct but non-obvious; a fixture would pin the anchor-selection interaction against future refactors.
AUTHOR="" degenerate case flips blank-login commits into anchors, changing which commits are counted; untested and defensive-only (AUTHOR normally non-empty). Worth a comment rather than a fixture.
